queries: WITH phase_averages AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS bandwidth_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(bandwidth_avg) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_averages) SELECT AVG(p.bandwidth_avg) AS avg_kept_bandwidth, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(p.bandwidth_avg - m.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess FROM phase_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE p.bandwidth_avg > m.mean_phase_avg;

WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth) AS avg_kept_bandwidth, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth) AS avg_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth;
